sections.heading: Description
lines: Corrosive Field is one of the Field Effects present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as a Telluric field.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: Grassy Terrain will transform into this field if the move Sludge Wave or the Z-Move Acid Downpour is used.
“The grassy terrain was corroded!”
Corrosive Mist Field will transform into this field if the move Gravity is used.
“The toxic mist collected on the ground!”

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Grass-type moves gain a Poison sub-type.
Field Damage:
This field has two sources of damage. Both are avoided by the following:
Airborne Pokémon.
Zangoose wielding the Zangoose Crest.
Poison-type and Steel-type Pokémon.
Pokémon with the abilities Immunity, Magic Guard, Pastel Veil, Poison Heal, Toxic Boost or Wonder Guard.
As of V14.0.22, Magic Guard isn't listed in the in-game Field Notes.
Pokémon take type-scaling Poison damage on switch-in, with normal damage equal to 1/4 max HP.
“[Pokémon] was seared by the corrosion!”
In this instance, Pokémon also take no field damage if they hold Heavy-Duty Boots.
Sleeping Pokémon lose 1/16 of their max HP each turn.
“[Pokémon] is seared by the corrosion!”

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Activated Abilities:
Merciless
Poison Heal
“[Pokémon] was healed by the poison!”
Toxic Boost
All three only activate if the user is grounded.
Buffed Abilities:
Corrosion boosts damage dealt by the user by 1.5x.
Toxic chain can poison Steel-type and Poison-type Pokémon.
Nerfed Abilities:
Grass Pelt causes the bearer to lose 1/8 max HP each turn.
“[Pokémon]'s pelt is withering!”

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Damage Modifiers: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Acid, Acid Spray, Grass Knot, Snap Trap → 2x boost.
“The corrosion strengthened the attack!”
Apple Acid, Mud Bomb, Mud Slap, Mud Shot, Muddy Water, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Whirlpool → 1.5x boost, Poison sub-typing.
“The corrosion strengthened the attack!”
Other Moves: Buffed Moves:
Acid Armor boosts the user's Defense by 3 stages.
Barb Barrage and Venoshock double in power regardless of status.
Poison Powder, Sleep Powder, Stun Spore and Toxic's accuracy are increased to 100%.
Toxic Spikes cannot be absorbed by Poison-type Pokémon.
Venom Drench can be activated regardless of status.
Nerfed Moves:
Ingrain damages the user for 1/16 max HP each turn instead of restoring it.
“Pokémon absorbed foul nutrients with its roots!”
Poison-type and Steel-type Pokémon still heal 1/16 max HP each turn as normal.
Pokémon with the Magic Guard ability are not damaged, but they do not heal.
Other Move Changes:
Floral Healing additionally poisons its target when healing it.
Field-dependent moves & Abilities:
Mimicry changes the bearer's type to Poison.
Camouflage changes the user's type to Poison.
Nature Power becomes Acid Spray.
Secret Power may inflict Poison.
Shelter halves damage from Poison-type moves.
Terrain Pulse becomes Poison-type.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost on top of any other previously listed modifiers.
This field will transform into Grassy Terrain if the moves Purify or Seed Flare are used.
“The polluted field was purified!”

sections.heading: Items
lines: Telluric Seed applies Baneful Bunker to the user.
“The Telluric Seed shielded [Pokémon] against damage!”
Zangoose Crest heals Zangoose if it's grounded, even if it's not poisoned.

sections.heading: Notes
lines: Prior to V14, some effects were different:
Nature Power became Acid instead of Acid Spray.
Grass Pelt did not damage the user if they were a Poison-type or a Steel-type.
Poison Heal recovers 1/16 of the user's max HP at the end of each turn if it's grounded.
